# Clinovian static validation report

**Release:** 2026.09.13-r2
**Generated:** 13 September 2026
**Generated by:** `python3 scripts/validate_site.py` — this file is written from the
script's actual output. Do not hand-edit it, and do not carry figures forward from a
previous release.

## What this gate is

A **static structural check**. It parses the repository and verifies a defined list of
mechanical properties. It is not a quality assessment, an accessibility conformance
result, a clinical review, or evidence that any page is correct.

## What it actually checks

- Required head metadata: title and description present and within length bounds,
  canonical, `og:url`, viewport, icons, font link
- Exactly one `<h1>` per page; `lang` attribute and `no-js` class present
- All JSON-LD blocks parse as JSON
- Internal links, fragments and local assets resolve to files that exist in the repo
- Every `<table>` sits inside a focusable scroll wrapper
- External links carry `target="_blank"` and a `rel` containing `noopener`
- `vercel.json` parses; no stray `_headers`/`_redirects`; internal docs are ignored
  from deployment
- `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml` (every URL exists on disk; every indexable page present)
  and `feed.xml` are well-formed
- Banned-phrase list: retired copy and internal-voice patterns do not reappear
- `main.js` parses (`node --check`) when node is available

### Regression checks added in this release

- **Service routing (F07):** every `contact.html?service=` value in the repository
  resolves to an option in the intake form, by stable `data-service-id` or by exact
  label. A CTA that cannot be resolved fails the gate.
- **Confirmation visibility (F03):** `#intake-status` is not a descendant of
  `#intake-form`.
- **Stale field serialisation (F11):** conditional intake groups are `<fieldset>`
  elements, so they can be disabled rather than only hidden.
- **Menu dismissal (F08):** `style.css` contains no `:hover`/`:focus-within` rule that
  can display a dropdown independently of the `.nav-item.open` state.
- **Known sample arithmetic (F02):** the AR specimen's four category counts sum to 47,
  its category balances sum to $1,274,000, and the five deadline-flagged
  clinical-review/missing-information accounts sum to $100,400.
- **Banned clinical assertion (F01):** the string "AKI is classified as an MCC" and the
  blanket "AKI as an MCC" formulation do not appear anywhere in the repository.
- **Specimen version metadata (F05):** every specimen page carries a document-control
  block with a specimen version and a review date.
- **PDF pairing (F14):** no page links to a `.pdf` that is not present in the repository.
- **Shared-region and service-data drift (F20):** `scripts/build_shared.py --check` is run
  by the gate. It fails if regenerating any shared region would change a page, if service
  names, prices or turnarounds diverge between `data/site.json`, `service-catalog.json` and
  the intake form, or if a service points at a file that does not exist.
- **Editorial apparatus (F15):** every article carries a reviewer byline, a last-review date,
  structured data naming a person as author, and a Sources section with an external primary link.
- **Withdrawn claims (F15):** claims removed for want of a source — the behavioural-health
  ranking, the "never appears in a denial dashboard" absolute, and an unqualified 95% figure —
  fail the gate if they reappear anywhere in the repository.

## What it does NOT check — and must never be claimed to

- **Medical, coding or regulatory accuracy.** No script validates a clinical statement.
  Material clinical and coding claims require separate review by a qualified reviewer,
  recorded in the clinical review log below.
- Accessibility conformance. No screen-reader, contrast, target-size, zoom/reflow or
  reduced-motion testing is performed here.
- Rendered layout at any viewport, on any real device or browser.
- Production response headers, redirect behaviour, TLS, DNS or host configuration.
- Core Web Vitals or any performance measurement.
- Form delivery to the destination inbox.
- Anything about the deployed site. This gate reads the repository only.

## Result for this release

Run `python3 scripts/validate_site.py` and paste its summary block here. A release is
not accepted on a passing gate alone — the acceptance checklist in `RELEASE_NOTES.md`
must also be satisfied, and the items marked "unverified" there remain unverified.
